description: Retrospective. Email and password auth through Better Auth, pointed at mi7rab's auth database so one account works across the umbrella's apps. Sessions were moved from Redis to Postgres after a free Upstash instance was reclaimed after 14 days idle and every app in the umbrella started 500ing on /api/auth/*. 3afya reads and writes the session table but never migrates it.
title: Stand up Better Auth against the shared auth database
